method: Each claim checked against the retrieved text of the ASHM mpox page. Vaccine doses, intervals and CD4 thresholds compared character by character. The tecovirimat source sentence contains an apparent typographical error in the original ('an export' for 'an expert'); it is recorded verbatim here and rendered with the evident meaning in the guideline. RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-22: the page in retrieved_from was fetched again and every claim attributed to this source was re-checked against it. Quotes stored from the earlier scrape carried that scrape's table and list markup (pipes, numbered list markers) into the quoted string; each was replaced with the text the page actually carries, located by alignment against the retrieved copy (scripts/repair_quotes.py). No dose, duration or concentration changed: the set of numbers in every repaired quote was compared before and after, and the only difference across 156 repaired quotes was list numerals 1-4 becoming bullets. Where a reference superscript falls inside a quoted sentence the page renders it inline, so it appears in source_text; it is part of the retrieved text, not part of the assertion.

claims.claim: Upon clinical suspicion of mpox, immediately phone the local public health unit for advice on exclusions and restrictions during the infectious period before the patient leaves the clinic
claims.source_text: Upon clinical suspicion of mpox, immediately phone the local public health unit for advice on exclusions and restrictions during their infectious period before the patient leaves the clinic.

claims.claim: The auditable outcome is that all cases of mpox are immediately discussed with the local Public Health Unit
claims.source_text: All cases of mpox are immediately discussed with the local Public Health Unit.

claims.claim: Patients who need hospital admission should be discussed with the receiving infectious diseases team prior to transport so biocontainment strategies can be enacted
claims.source_text: Patients who need to be admitted to hospital should be discussed with the receiving infectious diseases team prior to transport to hospital, to ensure that appropriate biocontainment strategies can be enacted.

claims.claim: Tecovirimat was made available through the National Medical Stockpile based on in vitro data, however two subsequent randomised controlled trials did not demonstrate clinical benefit, and people at significantly increased risk of severe disease should still be discussed with an expert as treatment may still be advised for some
claims.source_text: Tecovirimat was made available through the National Medical Stockpile based on in vitro data however two subsequent randomised controlled trials did not demonstrate clinical benefit. Nonetheless people at significantly increased risk of severe disease should be discussed with an export as treatment may still be advised for some people.

claims.claim: Common adverse effects of tecovirimat include headache, nausea, abdominal pain and vomiting, but it otherwise appears safe
claims.source_text: Common adverse effects of tecovirimat include headache, nausea, abdominal pain and vomiting, but it otherwise appears safe.

claims.claim: Vaccinia immunoglobulin is held in the National Medical Stockpile in limited quantities
claims.source_text: Vaccinia immunoglobulin (VIG) is held in the National Medical Stockpile in limited quantities.

claims.claim: In pregnancy VIG may be preferred over tecovirimat, and patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding should be considered for specific mpox treatment
claims.source_text: Pregnant people Patients who are pregnant or breast feeding should be considered for specific mpox treatment. In pregnancy, VIG may be preferred over Tecovirimat

claims.claim: Uncomplicated mpox is treated supportively with analgesia, antibiotics for secondary cellulitis and stool softeners for anal lesions
claims.source_text: Uncomplicated mpox virus infection Supportive treatment, including analgesia, antibiotics for secondary cellulitis, and stool softeners for anal lesions

claims.claim: Severe infection, those at risk of severe infection such as CD4 below 200, or those with complications such as eye infection or severe secondary cellulitis should be discussed with an infectious diseases or sexual health specialist regarding antiviral and/or immunoglobulin treatment
claims.source_text: Severe mpox virus infection, or in those at risk of severe infection (e.g., CD4 < 200 cells/uL), or in those with complications (e.g. eye infection, severe secondary cellulitis) Discuss with an infectious diseases or sexual health specialist whether antiviral and/or immunoglobulin (VIG) treatment is indicated

claims.claim: Most cases are mild and self-limited and do not require specific antiviral therapy
claims.source_text: Most cases are mild and self-limited, and do not require specific antiviral therapy.

claims.claim: Indications for urgent specialist discussion are severe disease such as sepsis, encephalitis or eye infection; one or more complications such as secondary cellulitis, dehydration or pneumonia; or risk of severe disease including immunocompromise with CD4 below 200, children, pregnancy and breastfeeding
claims.source_text: Indications for urgent discussion with a specialist include: (1) severe mpox disease (e.g. sepsis, encephalitis, eye infection); (2) one or more complications (e.g. secondary cellulitis, dehydration, pneumonia); or (3) those at risk of severe disease (e.g. immunocompromise such as CD4 count < 200 cells/uL, children, pregnancy, breastfeeding).

claims.claim: Consider early initiation of empiric antibiotics if secondary cellulitis is suspected
claims.source_text: Consider early initiation of empiric antibiotics if secondary cellulitis is suspected.

claims.claim: Consider strong analgesia for lesions in troublesome areas such as the oropharynx and anorectum, topical lignocaine for painful lesions, and stool softeners for anal lesions
claims.source_text: Consider strong analgesia for mpox lesions in troublesome areas such as the oropharynx and anorectum. - Painful lesions may benefit from topical lignocaine. - Anal lesions may benefit from stool softeners

claims.claim: Best-practice wound care for mpox lesions is important to reduce the risk of cellulitis
claims.source_text: Best-practice wound care for mpox lesions is important to reduce the risk of cellulitis.

claims.claim: Anorectal pain may require management in hospital
claims.source_text: Severe pain from lesions. Anorectal pain may require management in hospital (uncommon)

claims.claim: Testing is only indicated when patients present with symptoms suspected of being due to mpox, and asymptomatic screening or testing of asymptomatic contacts is not recommended as asymptomatic carriage appears rare
claims.source_text: Testing is only indicated when patients present with symptoms suspected of being due to mpox virus. - Asymptomatic screening, or testing asymptomatic contacts for mpox is not recommended, as asymptomatic carriage appears rare

claims.claim: Lesion fluid NAAT on a dry swab is ideally collected when a vesicle or pustule is de-roofed
claims.source_text: Lesion fluid NAAT of dry swab Ideally collected when a vesicle or pustule is de-roofed

claims.claim: Lesion tissue or crust NAAT in a dry container is the best test if no fluid-filled vesicles or pustules are available
claims.source_text: Lesion tissue or crust NAAT of material in dry container Best test if no fluid-filled vesicles or pustules are available for testing

claims.claim: An anorectal swab is an alternative if the patient has anal symptoms and cannot tolerate anoscopy, and is not recommended for use without symptoms
claims.source_text: Anorectal swab NAAT of dry swab Alternative test if patient presents with anal symptoms and cannot tolerate anoscopy for collection of sample under direct vision. Not recommended for use without symptoms

claims.claim: Contact the local laboratory prior to specimen collection to check availability of mpox NAAT, or the nearest hospital laboratory to arrange transport
claims.source_text: Contact your local laboratory prior to specimen collection to check the availability of mpox tests (NAAT). Alternatively, contact your nearest hospital laboratory to arrange transport of specimen(s).

claims.claim: Dry swab transport tubes are preferred to avoid leakage and allow correct processing; bacterial culture swabs containing gel media are not acceptable for NAAT testing
claims.source_text: Dry swab transport tubes are the preferred option to avoid the risk of leakage during transport and allows for laboratory staff to process the specimen appropriately. ... Use of bacterial culture swabs (e.g. containing gel media for bacterial preservation) is not acceptable to perform NAAT testing.

claims.claim: Where there are distinct anatomical or morphological lesions consider swabbing at least 2 lesions with separate swabs and write the lesion site on the specimen containers
claims.source_text: Where there are distinct anatomical or morphological lesions consider swabbing at least 2 lesions with separate swabs, and write the lesion site on the specimen containers.

claims.claim: Wear adequate PPE including gown, gloves, surgical mask and eye protection, and avoid contact with contaminated materials such as bedding
claims.source_text: Wear adequate PPE, including gown, gloves, surgical mask, and eye protection. - Avoid contact with contaminated materials (e.g., bedding

claims.claim: Public laboratories have implemented mpox-specific PCR/NAAT assays, some laboratories may still use Orthopox assays, and some commercial laboratories do not have a specific assay
claims.source_text: Public laboratories have implemented mpox-specific PCR/NAAT assays. - Some laboratories may still use Orthopox PCR/NAAT assays instead. - Some commercial laboratories do not have a specific assay

claims.claim: Swab suspected mpox lesions for HSV PCR, syphilis PCR and LGV PCR as important differential diagnoses, consider M/C/S as secondary bacterial cellulitis is common, and perform a full HIV/STI screen at presentation as co-infection is common
claims.source_text: Swab suspected mpox lesions for HSV PCR, syphilis PCR, and LGV PCR, as these are important differential diagnoses. - Consider swabbing suspected mpox lesions for M/C/S, as secondary bacterial cellulitis is common. - Perform full HIV/STI screen at time of presentation, as co-infection with HIV/STIs is common

claims.claim: Mpox is vaccine-preventable using JYNNEOS, a brand name of replication-deficient modified vaccinia Ankara, Bavarian Nordic, or MVA-BN
claims.source_text: Mpox is vaccine-preventable using JYNNEOS (a brand name of replication-deficient modified vaccinia Ankara - Bavarian Nordic, or MVA-BN).

claims.claim: A standard primary vaccination course of MVA-BN requires 2 subcutaneous doses each of 0.5 mL given 4 weeks apart, with subcutaneous injection the preferred route
claims.source_text: A standard primary vaccination course of MVA-BN mpox vaccine requires 2 subcutaneous doses, each of 0.5 mL, given 4 weeks apart. Subcutaneous injection is the preferred route of administration.

claims.claim: Vaccination is recommended for GBMSM including transgender and gender-diverse people, sex workers particularly those whose clients are at risk, people with HIV if at risk, others whose sexual networks might include GBMSM, and laboratory personnel working with orthopoxviruses; it may also be considered for healthcare workers at risk
claims.source_text: gay, bisexual or other men who have sex with men (GBMSM), including transgender and gender-diverse people - sex workers, particularly those whose clients are at risk of mpox exposure - people with HIV, if at risk of mpox exposure - other individuals whose sexual networks might include GBMSM - laboratory personnel working with orthopoxviruses - Vaccination may also be considered for healthcare workers at risk of exposure to patients with mpox

claims.claim: Post-exposure preventive vaccination is recommended for anyone categorised by public health authorities as a high-risk mpox contact within the past 14 days
claims.source_text: Post-exposure preventive vaccination is recommended for anyone categorised by public health authorities as a high-risk mpox contact within the past 14 days.

claims.claim: Seek immediate local Public Health Unit assistance with contact tracing, and contacts are stratified as low-risk, medium-risk or high-risk
claims.source_text: Seek immediate local Public Health Unit assistance with contact tracing. - Contacts are stratified as low-risk, medium-risk, or high-risk

claims.claim: Medium and high-risk contacts should be offered post-exposure vaccination with a subcutaneous dose of 3rd-generation vaccinia vaccine ideally within 4 days of last contact but up to 14 days, and vaccination more than 4 days after last contact may not prevent infection but may attenuate disease severity
claims.source_text: Medium and high-risk contacts should be offered post-exposure vaccination with a subcutaneous dose of 3 rd -generation vaccinia vaccine (i.e., MVA), ideally within 4 days of last contact, but up to 14 days of last contact. Post-exposure vaccination more than 4 days after last contact may not prevent infection, but it may attenuate disease severity

claims.claim: Contacts who receive post-exposure vaccination should receive a subcutaneous dose at least 28 days after the initial dose unless they develop mpox in the interim
claims.source_text: Contacts who receive post-exposure vaccination should receive a subcutaneous vaccine dose at least 28 days after their initial subcutaneous dose, unless they develop mpox infection in the interim.

claims.claim: Cases are considered infectious until scabs have fallen off and a fresh layer of skin has formed, and cases with anal pain or bleeding are infectious until anal symptoms have completely resolved
claims.source_text: Cases are considered infectious until scabs have fallen off and a fresh layer of skin has formed. - Cases with anal pain/bleeding are considered infectious until their anal symptoms have completely resolved

claims.claim: Mpox viral DNA has been found in semen of recovered men raising the possibility of transmission via semen for some weeks, but no definitive transmissions via semen from someone recently recovered have been documented, and people with a penis may wish to use condoms for some time after recovery
claims.source_text: Mpox viral DNA has been found in the semen of men who have recovered from clinical mpox disease. This raises the possibility that mpox could be transmitted via semen for some weeks following clinical infection. However, to date there have been no definitive mpox transmissions via semen from someone who has recently recovered from mpox. For this reason, people who have a penis and who have recently recovered from mpox may wish to use condoms for some time after recovery

claims.claim: Pets are at risk of infection and may need to be re-housed temporarily during isolation
claims.source_text: Pets are at risk of infection and this risk should be considered during isolation, and may need to be re-housed temporarily to avoid the risk of mpox transmission to the pet.

claims.claim: Patients with laboratory-confirmed mpox are considered immune from re-infection at least in the short to medium term and do not need immunisation
claims.source_text: Patients with laboratory-confirmed mpox infection are considered to be immune from re-infection, at least in the short to medium term after recovery, and hence do not need immunisation.

claims.claim: Test of cure is not necessary as mpox is self-limiting, and re-testing for mpox is not necessary
claims.source_text: TOC is not necessary, as this is a self-limiting infection. ... Re-testing for mpox is not necessary.

claims.claim: Arrange regular clinical reviews by telehealth while the patient is isolating to assess recovery, emergence of complications and need for assistance with isolation
claims.source_text: Depending on clinical severity, arrange regular clinical reviews by telehealth while the patient is isolating to assess progress of recovery, emergence of complications, and need for assistance with isolation.

claims.claim: Offer HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis to anyone who has recovered from mpox after appropriate assessment
claims.source_text: Offer HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis to anyone who has recovered from mpox, after conducting appropriate assessment.

claims.claim: A global clade II outbreak started in 2022 with increased Australian cases in 2022 and 2024, almost exclusively diagnosed among men who have sex with men and transmitted through sexual and other similarly close contact, with ongoing risk in Australia
claims.source_text: A global outbreak of mpox (formerly known as monkeypox) clade II started in 2022, with increased numbers of cases occurring in Australia during 2022 and 2024. Within this outbreak, mpox infection has almost exclusively been diagnosed among men who have sex with men, transmitted through sexual contact and other similarly close contact. As cases continue to occur in many countries, there is an ongoing risk within Australia.

claims.claim: A separate clade I outbreak commenced in 2023 in some African countries, clade I is associated with greater disease severity, and there have been very few clade I cases in Australia with no evidence of sustained transmission to date
claims.source_text: A separate clade I outbreak commenced in 2023 in some African countries. Clade I infections are associated with greater disease severity. There have been very few cases of clade I detected in Australia, and no evidence of sustained transmission to date.

claims.claim: Lesions evolve from macules to papules to vesicles to pustules to crusted scabs and typically last 3 weeks but can be longer, while prodromal symptoms typically last up to 5 days
claims.source_text: Lesions evolve from macules, to papules, to vesicles, to pustules, to crusted scabs. Typically last 3 weeks, but can be longer. ... Prodromal symptoms: Generalised centrifugal rash, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, muscle pain, joint pain, back pain. Typically last up to 5 days.

claims.claim: Asymptomatic mpox infection is rare
claims.source_text: Asymptomatic infection is rare.

claims.claim: Secondary bacterial cellulitis of affected skin or mucosal surfaces is a common complication
claims.source_text: Secondary bacterial cellulitis of affected skin or mucosal surfaces (common)

claims.claim: Complications are more common in people who are immunocompromised such as people living with HIV with a CD4 count below 200
claims.source_text: Complications are more common in people who are immunocompromised, such as people living with HIV with a CD4 count < 200 cells/uL.

claims.claim: Closely monitor people living with HIV with CD4 below 200, an AIDS diagnosis in the preceding six months, or persistent HIV viraemia above 200 copies per mL
claims.source_text: Closely monitor PLHIV with a CD4 count < 200 cells/uL, or with an AIDS diagnosis in the preceding six months, or with persistent HIV viraemia (HIV VL > 200 copies/mL).

claims.claim: Children especially under 10 years old should be discussed with an infectious disease paediatrician as they are at increased risk of severe infection
claims.source_text: Children (especially if < 10 years old) Discuss with an infectious disease paediatrician, as children are at increased risk of severe infection

claims.claim: Mpox is caused by monkeypox virus, an enveloped double-stranded DNA virus of the genus Orthopoxvirus
claims.source_text: Monkeypox virus, an enveloped double-stranded DNA virus of the genus Orthopoxvirus.
